experiment: E3 accounting pass with per-op FLOPs (LeRobot models)
command: for m in pi0 pi05 smolvla: env -u HF_TOKEN -u HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 ~/venvs/lerobot/bin/python bench/run_e3.py --model $m --accounting-only --out results/20261022_E3_lerobot_accounting_flop_ops
notes: The LeRobot E3 runs (bench a32aa34) predate the per-op FLOP breakdown (flop_ops); this pass adds it. FLOP and byte totals must equal those runs' accounting.json (checked in summary.md).
